lines.t: Oh, oh, oh
Oh, oh, oh
From the heavens I am calling
My voice thunders, yet it's kind
Through the storm and through the stillness
I am searching hearts to find
I have written you in mercy
Bound with love that will not end
My arms are open, child returning
Forsaken paths now mend
Oh, my bride, awaken, rise
The dawn is painted in your eyes
I have waited through the night
For your heart, my heart's delight
Come away, the feast is near
The kingdom's gates are drawing clear
For the spirit and the bride say come
And love is all you'll hear
The time of tears is fading
The final trumpet soon will sing
The shadows flee before my coming
Heaven's glory I will bring
You are chosen pure and holy
Clothed in white by my own hand
In your eyes I see forever
The promise I have planned
Oh my bride, awake and rise
The dawn is painted in your eyes
I have waited through the night For your heart, my heart's delight
Come away, the feast is near The kingdom's gates are drawing clear
For the spirit and the bride say come And love is all you'll hear
Do you not feel my longing fire? Do you not hear the spirits cry?
I have made a home eternal where no sorrow can abide
Oh my bride, awaken, rise, behold your king stands at the skies
The table's set, the vows are true, my every word fulfilled in you
Come away, the hour is here, eternal union drawing near
For the spirit and the bride say come
Forever I am near
